records.title: Textile Processing HUBS
details:
a to b: the scheme is being implemented for completing ongoing projects only.
Under the Scheme, 6 projects have been sanctioned which are under implementation. State wise
1. Balotra Water Pollution Control Treatment & Reverse Osmosis Private Ltd, Rajasthan
2. Jasol Water Pollution Control Treatment & Reverse Osmosis Private Limited, Rajasthan
3. Sanganer Enviro Project Development, Rajasthan
4. Nextgen Textile Park, Rajasthan
5. Pali Common Effluent Treatment Plant, Rajasthan
6. Gujarat Eco Textile Park. Gujarat
(ii)the Government has also approved setting up of 7 (Seven) PM Mega
Integrated Textile Region and Apparel (PM MITRA) Parks in Greenfield/Brownfield sites with scheme outlay of Rs. 4,445 crore for the period 2021-22 to 2027-28. The Government has finalised 7 sites viz. Tamil Nadu (Virudhnagar), Telangana (Warangal), Gujarat (Navsari), Karnataka (Kalaburagi), Madhya Pradesh (Dhar), Uttar Pradesh (Lucknow) and Maharashtra (Amravati) for setting up PM MITRA Park
